properties.name: Vasilikos Power Station (EAC)
properties.fuelType: Heavy Fuel Oil (HFO) / Gas-Oil / Natural Gas Ready
properties.description: Cyprus's largest baseload power generation facility. Houses 3x 130 MW steam turbine units, CCGT Unit 4 (220 MW), CCGT Unit 5 (220 MW), and emergency aero-derivative gas turbines.
properties.environmentalCompliance: Industrial Emissions Directive (IED) compliant with De-SOx scrubbers.

properties.name: Dhekelia Power Station (EAC)
properties.fuelType: Heavy Fuel Oil / Low Sulfur Diesel
properties.description: Eastern generation pillar providing essential voltage support and inertia for the eastern transmission loop. Operates under CERA phase-out and storage conversion roadmap.
properties.environmentalCompliance: Operating under EU derogation mechanisms with scheduled transition to hybrid BESS.

properties.name: Moni Peaking Power Station (EAC)
properties.description: Strategic black-start and peak-load support facility deployed during severe grid contingencies or extreme summer demand spikes.

properties.name: Geri – Nisou Utility PV Cluster
properties.description: Cyprus's premier utility-scale solar generation cluster spanning over 65 hectares along the central farming plains. Features computerized smart inverter curtailment controls.

properties.name: Arediou – Agrokipia Solar Park
properties.description: Large-scale utility PV park evacuating power through the dedicated 132kV Anageia substation. Pioneered commercial PPA off-take contracts in Cyprus.

properties.name: Marki – Kotchatis Utility Solar
properties.description: Utility solar development integrated with automated SCADA telemetry linked directly to TSOC dispatching algorithms.

properties.name: Frenaros – Sotira Regional Solar Cluster
properties.description: Famagusta regional solar cluster providing green energy to eastern coastal tourism zones and municipal desalination plants.

properties.name: Bioland Aradippou Solar Park
properties.description: High-yield facility located outside Larnaca. Features remote robotic dry-cleaning system for arid conditions.

properties.name: Vassiliko Industrial Autoproduction PV
properties.description: Direct behind-the-meter industrial solar park powering cement clinker manufacturing, significantly cutting industrial heavy fuel consumption.

properties.name: Orites Wind Farm (Kouklia, Paphos)
properties.description: Cyprus's largest utility wind energy installation spanning across the southern Paphos coastal mountain ridges. Generates essential night-time renewable baseload for the national grid.

properties.name: Alexigros Wind Farm (Klavdia, Larnaca)
properties.description: Located on the dry hilltops of southern Larnaca district. Features specialized low-wind micro-siting to maximize afternoon thermal sea breezes.

properties.name: Agia Anna Wind Farm
properties.description: Central ridge wind farm delivering consistent green megawatts into the Kofinou transmission substation.
